scope: Visual effect only on body.page-id-256. Reference read-only. No other page, global template, media, plugin setting, SMTP or external message write.

page_precondition.note: Re-read page256 immediately before any CSS write. If any value differs, stop and reconcile live drift first.

technology_section: Source direct eyebrow has a 16px bronze leaf; target legacy eyebrow lacks it.
Source section intro is 1.125rem / max-width 104ch and wraps to two lines at sampled desktop; target is 16px and one line.
Source three cards use 32px padding, organic radius, soft shadow, lower-right organic watermark; target uses 26px padding and simple 24px radius.
Source middle sage card has no shadow, source sage surface, top botanical hairline and darker watermark.
Target card widths/content/icons are otherwise aligned, so the CSS block deliberately preserves current icon generation and content.
symptom_table: Saved table text and row/column semantics are already source-exact and must not change.
Source .table-wrap uses organic radius, soft shadow and horizontal-scroll edge treatment; target uses simple 24px radius/no shadow.
Source cell padding is 13px 24px; target is 15px 16px.
Source header is sage and letter-spaced; target header is paper beige.
faq: Question names/accessibility are already source-exact and must remain so.
Source FAQ uses 22/26px organic cards, 64px triggers, hover sage treatment and leaf-shaped plus/minus control.
Target uses native details/summary with simple 15px radius and no source-equivalent trigger icon. CSS mapping preserves native details behavior without DOM or text replacement.

required_predeploy_reads: Exact WPVibe quota; preserve at least 10 calls after complete write/readback/QA package.
Page256 Elementor bytes/SHA/JSON validity; must match 35382 / 55fd9bbe...990f3 / valid.
Fresh complete Additional CSS length/SHA plus unique af-project:end marker and absence of af-bio-visual-v001 marker.
Target CSS pseudo ownership: prove whether .af-sub-cards>article::after or equivalent is already used. If article::after is occupied, do not deploy the watermark rules until reconciled.
Confirm current target technology icon generation remains visually present and is not owned by the same pseudo-element the new watermark needs.
suggested_compact_css_preflight_sql: SELECT LENGTH(post_content) AS bytes, SHA2(post_content,256) AS sha256, LOCATE('af-bio-visual-v001',post_content) AS marker_pos, LOCATE('/* af-project:end */',post_content) AS end_pos, LOCATE('.af-sub-cards>article::before',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS tech_before2, LOCATE('.af-sub-cards>article:before',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS tech_before1, LOCATE('.af-sub-cards>article::after',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS tech_after2, LOCATE('.af-sub-cards>article:after',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS tech_after1, LOCATE('.af-details summary::after',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS faq_after2, LOCATE('.af-details summary:after',REPLACE(post_content,' ','')) AS faq_after1 FROM {prefix}posts WHERE ID=8
deployment: Use supported /wpvibe/v1/content/search on post8 post_content to retrieve the exact unique af-project:end snippet from the fresh field.

Insert the complete marked CSS block immediately before the unique project end marker using one guarded match-once /wpvibe/v1/content/edit. Do not round-trip or replace the whole Additional CSS field.
Treat HTTP 429 on the write as UNKNOWN. Do not retry; first read back marker/hash to determine whether it executed.
Read back Additional CSS bytes/SHA/marker count and re-read page256 Elementor bytes/SHA/JSON. Page256 saved data must remain unchanged.

Fresh-load source and target with only the existing two Opera tabs. Verify technology card geometry/surfaces, table surface, FAQ static state, exact AX semantics and no regression of hero/reviews/CTA.
If a measured regression appears, remove only the exact af-bio-visual-v001 marked block by guarded match-once edit; do not restore an old full Additional CSS snapshot.
intentionally_open: #technologiak anchor ownership/offset: target id is currently on inner af-sub-inner; do not guess a scroll-margin or structural ID move without a supported outer-wrapper ID proof.
Stress and expectations split/list card visuals need additional direct source-target screenshot/component mapping before inclusion.
Global header active-state and floating-contact differences are outside page256-only scope.
Deterministic six-viewport screenshot/overlay/diff remains unavailable; PIXEL_PASS stays false until that evidence exists.
host_throttle: Latest site calls still return HTTP 429 after three automatic retries. Do not deploy while throttle is active.
